# aj config

Show or change your defaults.


## `aj config show`

Show every setting, the active account and where the config lives.

```text
aj config show [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj config set`

Set a default, e.g. `aj config set project DEMO`.

```text
aj config set NAME VALUE [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | required | One of: project, issue-type, board, editor. |
| `VALUE` | required | The value. |


## `aj config unset`

Remove a default.

```text
aj config unset NAME [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NAME` | required | One of: project, issue-type, board, editor. |


## `aj config path`

Print where the config file lives.

```text
aj config path [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
